verdict.rationale: Databricks documents Lakeflow pipelines with Auto Loader for ETL and says it can incrementally process new data files as they arrive in cloud storage. It also documents standard ingestion connectors and Structured Streaming with low latency and exactly-once Delta sinks. A community report that Databricks saves configuration and infra wiring corroborates the managed aspect only in general terms. missing for 10: explicit documentation that ingestion pipelines run on fully managed/serverless infrastructure, named event-stream sources (e.g., message buses) for event ingestion, independent hands-on corroboration of continuous ingestion specifically
